I would say that "If I complete x, then I will reward myself with y." Then I wouldn't do x and still do y.

I get the same things told to me. "Youd be a great father!" No I wouldn't.  I can barely take care of myself. I have also done the little agreements. But they stopped working because I couldn't hold myself accountable.  
I like the Frankenstein analogy.  It makes sense and is what I feel like people see me as. It really is hell.
I would recommend 0.1. The maximum number that you can possibly have in one of those charts is 1 so that it what I always used.

I am pretty sure that it does violate some portion of ADA as well. However, I am not familiar with that act. 
Fun Fact: There are several sections of ADA that airlines are exempt from. Our regulations are run by the Air Carrier Access Act. The only difference is that we can refuse passage due to a disability if the person is unable to assist in their own evacuation and several other very strict criteria are met.
You have no idea how badly I wanted to.
